changeSummary.20261112053140_hod_cross_department_dele: Allows an HOD to delegate owned open work to active internal Staff with a login across departments. The target must be Staff, must not be banned or deleted, must have an auth login, and must not hold an HOD custom role. The actor must own the task through assignedTo or responsibleHodId, keep manageCreatedTasks, and may not change department, project, client, completion or a locked status. The HOD remains responsibleHodId, the assignment trigger stamps server attribution and assigned_staff, and review routing continues to use the task department. The scoped eligibility lookup is HOD-only, and existing PM and ordinary Staff boundaries are unchanged.
